description: A small Python library whose unit tests only run through the Makefile test target.

trap.note: textkit refuses to be imported under unittest unless TEXTKIT_CACHE is set; make test sets it to a scratch file.

prompts.text: Add a function `slugify` to textkit.py that lowercases the text and replaces spaces with hyphens (`slugify('Hello World')` returns `hello-world`), with a unit test in tests/test_slugify.py, and make sure the tests pass.
solution:
cat > tests/test_slugify.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import textkit


class SlugifyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_slugify(self):
        self.assertEqual(str(textkit.slugify('Hello World')), 'hello-world')
EOF

prompts.text: Add a function `truncate` to textkit.py that cuts the text to at most n characters and appends `...` when it was cut (`truncate('abcdefgh', 5)` returns `abcde...`, shorter text is returned unchanged), with a unit test in tests/test_truncate.py, and make sure the tests pass.
solution:
cat >> textkit.py <<'EOF'


def truncate(text, n):
    return text if len(text) <= n else text[:n] + '...'
EOF

cat > tests/test_truncate.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import textkit


class TruncateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_truncate(self):
        self.assertEqual(str(textkit.truncate('abcdefgh', 5)), 'abcde...')
EOF

prompts.text: Add a function `is_palindrome` to textkit.py that tells whether the text reads the same backwards, ignoring case (`is_palindrome('Level')` returns True), with a unit test in tests/test_is_palindrome.py, and make sure the tests pass.
solution:
cat >> textkit.py <<'EOF'


def is_palindrome(text):
    t = text.lower()
    return t == t[::-1]
EOF

cat > tests/test_is_palindrome.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import textkit


class IsPalindromeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_is_palindrome(self):
        self.assertEqual(str(textkit.is_palindrome('Level')), 'True')
EOF
